name: Battle Planner
benefit: When using the inspire action ability to grant an extra move action, you can affect all allies within 30 feet.
flavor: Your study of heroes and combat has made you exceptionally suited for directing allies to their most advantageous positions.
text:
Your study of heroes and combat has made you exceptionally suited for directing allies to their most advantageous positions.

**Prerequisites**: Inspire action class feature.

**Benefit**: When using the inspire action ability to grant an extra move action, you can affect all allies within 30 feet.
